Curriculum · Banking, Insurance & NBFC

Everything you learn before your first salary.

Six weeks, built backwards from the jobs. Every track starts with the same BFSI foundation, then goes deep into the products, rules and daily targets of one role, and ends with interviews.

6 weeks5 days a week, 4 hours a day
120 hrsabout half of it practice and role-play
3 trackspick one after the foundation

WEEKS 3–5 · 60 HRSYour career track + certification prep

Weeks 1–2 · Everyone

BFSI Foundation

The shared base every bank, insurer and NBFC expects on day one. It also lets you try all three worlds before you choose a track.

Weeks 3–5 · Choose one

Career tracks

Six modules of about 10 hours each, a certification your employer will ask for, and a capstone you can talk about in interviews.

Week 6 · Everyone

Placement sprint

Turning training into an offer letter, and understanding that offer before you sign it.

How you graduate
